description: Fetch a public HTTPS URL and extract structured page metadata: title, description, keywords, canonical, language, charset, full OpenGraph dictionary, Twitter Card, favicon (absolute URL), hreflang map, JSON-LD blocks, response headers and counts (h1/h2/images/links/scripts). SSRF-protected: refuses private/loopback/link-local/cloud-metadata addresses and re-validates every redirect. 2 MB body cap.

url.description: http:// or https:// URL to fetch.

name: url_metadata
